youtube.title: Four Seasons for Kids! Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
One tree, one camera spot, a whole year! Robo's fast-forward button takes Frog, Bear and Chick through spring, summer, autumn and winter: the weather, the light, the falling leaves and snow, and Bear's long winter sleep. And Robo's forecasts are always wrong!
For first graders learning about weather and seasons. Keep a weather chart for a week, and never look straight at the sun!

do.text: One tree on a hill. And my big red button!
It's a fast-forward button. It zooms through a whole year!
Press it! Press it!
Whoa! Stop! What just happened to our tree?
Let's go slowly. One season at a time.
season
Spring, summer, autumn, winter. Four seasons!
spring, summer, autumn, winter
Spring! The weather gets warmer.
spring
warm
There are gentle, rainy showers.
rainy
The rain helps flowers grow. Pop, pop, pop!
New green leaves grow on the tree.
Spring is when many baby animals are born. Look!
Peep! Hello, spring!
And who is waking up in the den?
Good morning! I'm so hungry after my long sleep.
Here's my forecast. Hot and sunny all day!
No? Not quite?
Right. Spring is mild, with rain showers.
Spring: sprout up from a crouch! Round and round, the seasons go.
Summer! The weather is hot and sunny.
summer
hot
The tree is big, full and green.
The sun sits high in the sky.
Summer days are long. It can still be light at bedtime!
Fun fact: summer has more hours of daylight than winter.
daylight
It's so hot! Fan yourself with me!
Peep! I'm growing up!
Today's summer forecast: snow!
No! No snow in summer!
Oops! Summer is hot and sunny.
Summer: fan yourself! Round and round, the seasons go.
Autumn, also called fall. The weather gets cooler.
autumn (fall)
cool
It is often windy too.
windy
What will happen to the leaves?
They turn yellow, orange and red!
Then the leaves fall. Twirl like a falling leaf!
Fun fact: the green fades away in autumn.
Then the yellow and orange that were there all along show!
Autumn means I eat lots. I'm getting ready for winter!
Autumn forecast: beach day!
No? Too cool for the beach?
You're right. Autumn is cool and windy.
Autumn: twirl like a leaf! Round and round, the seasons go.
Winter! The weather is cold and snowy.
winter
cold
snowy
In many places, snow covers the ground. Brrr!
Shiver and hug yourself!
Fun fact: snowflakes usually have six sides or six arms.
I'm sleepy. Good night!
Many bears sleep through much of winter in a den.
den
Many frogs rest too! In mud, or under leaves, until spring.
Winter days are short. It gets dark early.
Night comes early in winter. Then morning comes again.
Winter forecast: flowers everywhere!
No! No flowers in the snow!
Oops! Winter is cold and maybe snowy. Wear a warm coat!
Winter: shiver and hug! Round and round, the seasons go.
What comes after winter? Let's see the whole year.
Spring, summer, autumn, winter...
...and then spring again! The seasons go round.
Days get longer, then shorter, then longer again.
Now a season sort! Which season is it?
A sunny beach day with a beach ball!
Summer!
summer
A snowman!
Winter!
winter
Falling orange leaves!
Autumn, or fall!
autumn, fall
Flowers popping up!
Spring!
spring
Seasons quiz! Think, then shout your answer.
Seasons Quiz
Question one. Which season comes after winter?
Spring!
Question two. When do many trees lose their leaves?
Autumn, or fall!
Question three. Snowy and cold. Which season?
Winter!
Question four. Which season has the longest days?
Summer!
Last one. What does Bear do in winter?
He sleeps in his den!
Five out of five! Great job, weather watchers!
Spring again! Wake up, Bear!
spring
I'm awake! And hungry again!
My forecast for spring: mild and rainy!
Robo, that's right!
Hooray! I got it right!
Spring, summer, autumn, winter, and round again!
Bye, friends! See you next season!
